text:
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks for joining the post-all-hands Q&A — dropping this thread for follow-ups about mid-year reviews, leveling clarifications, promos, comp moves, and benefits parity. Well post a short FAQ + timeline by Friday EOD.

Raj (Eng): Quick one on retro pay: if a promo is approved with a 7/1 effective date but payroll missed the cutoff, do folks get backpay?

Olivia (Comp): Yes — we process backpay in the next payroll run after the effective date is entered. It appears as a separate line called "promo adjustment" and can take one extra cycle for final accounting.

Maya (SWE): For teammates in EMEA/APAC: will band moves and market adjustments be applied the same as US folks? Curious about equity vs cash mix.

Tom (People Ops): We run regional market refreshes. This cycle we prioritize locations where comp deficits exceed ~10% vs local medians. Equity/cash mixes differ by jurisdiction; Comp will publish regional guidance and examples after budget sign-off.

Devon (Manager): About nominations  how strict is the two-peer reviewer rule? Small orgs sometimes can't get two direct peers.

Aisha (People Ops): Not a hard block. If two peer reviews aren't available, include cross-team partner feedback (PM/Design/TPM) and note the reason. Calibration chairs accept substitutes but will flag packets lacking peers.

Raj (Eng): Is there an appeals path if someone thinks calibration missed important context?

Tom (People Ops): Yes. Appeals window is 10 business days after letters go out. Appeals must come from the manager and include material new evidence (metrics, customer/partner feedback, code review links). People Ops + calibration chair will triage.

Maya (SWE): Any changes to promotion cadence? Some teams do quarterly check-ins.

Aisha (People Ops): Official cadence stays mid-year and end-of-year. Off-cycle nominations are allowed for exceptional cases but handled case-by-case; they require an expedited packet and manager justification.

Devon (Manager): Parental leave question: will people on leave be disadvantaged for promo consideration? Also, top-up pay interactions?

Olivia (Comp): We do not penalize paid parental leave. Leave is exempt from negative calibration. Managers should document return-to-work impact in the packet. If top-up overlaps with promo or comp moves, Comp will coordinate prorated calculations.

payroll-bot: Payroll cut-off dates: July payroll cut-off = 2026-06-20; changes confirmed after that post in August payroll.

Aisha (People Ops): Ops notes for managers: attach a one-line impact bullet + two signal lines (metrics / feedback / ownership) to each packet; flag international exceptions; keep appeals evidence handy. Well publish the FAQ, cut-off calendar, and the updated promo packet template in #announcements by Friday EOD. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
